purpose: Teach: 月収/出来高/同上/組合せ/既定/特約/あっせん/引き渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究員の月収相場を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, check the standard monthly salary range for researchers.
lines.style: Crisp, direct task assignment. Measured tempo. Boss-to-junior authority without coldness. Brief pause after the name to ensure attention. Clear-eyed expectation that this will be done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文出来高に応じた賞与制度を学習しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the bonus structure tied to paper publications.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Careful enunciation on key terms. Slight formal stiffness — showing he's understood the gravity. Brief, efficient. The tone of someone eager to prove he's listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の参考文献に同上を多用するな
lines.en: Ren, don't overuse 'ditto' citations in your paper references.
lines.style: Calm correction, not scolding. Measured pace. The kind of feedback that expects understanding, not defense. Weight on the word 'overuse' — gentle but firm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験条件の組合せ表を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a combination matrix for the experimental conditions.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Slightly faster than before — showing he's absorbing the feedback. Precise and formal. The voice of someone taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、既定の実験手順を守れ
lines.en: Ren, follow the established experimental protocol exactly.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Not angry, but the pressure underneath is clear. Direct eye contact in the voice. Each word deliberate. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会との特約契約を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the special contract terms with the conference.
lines.style: More alert now. Registers the shift in tone. Proper, controlled. Shorter, tighter delivery. Showing he understood the seriousness of the last instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、留学先のあっせんを大学に依頼しろ
lines.en: Ren, have the university arrange your study abroad placement.
lines.style: Back to assignment mode. Slightly softer than the protocol correction — this is forward-looking, not corrective. Still direct. Tempo steady. A senior's confidence in the junior's trajectory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料の引き渡し手続を覚えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll learn the sample handover procedures.
lines.style: Closing note of resolve. Slightly quieter than the middle lines. Careful enunciation on 'handover procedures.' The slight trailing-off suggests he's mentally checking off the list. Professional, resolved.
